caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a simple and rectangular structure. The chest is colored in light beige and has visible wood grain texture, with some parts appearing slightly darker, particularly on the right side panel and the top surface. The chest has two horizontal drawers at the front, each equipped with a pair of round, dark brown knobs located symmetrically on the left and right sides of the drawers. The lower edge of the chest features a curved cut-out design that creates an arch at each side, giving the base a decorative appearance. The chest stands directly on the floor, without any visible legs. The background is plain and uniformly light in color, devoid of any additional objects or details.
title: Shaker Blanket Chest
